driver.text: An AI-fueled tech rally led the gains; talk of Anthropic's IPO lifted chip stocks for a third straight session. Energy was the weakest sector as crude eased on Middle East peace negotiations. The Fed began its October meeting, widely expected to hold rates at 3.75%-4%; CME FedWatch points to a possible hike in December. Meta fell 1.6% after raising its equity fundraising to $97.5B; Boeing fell 10.7% on a larger-than-expected Q3 loss. Microsoft and Alphabet report Wednesday, Amazon Thursday. SOX and 10Y yield closing levels not verified from an allowed source.

items.headline: Nvidia to invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering
items.summary: Meta raised its planned offerings to $97.5B (incl. $25B common stock at $625/share, ~$12.5B convertible preferred, up to $60B at-the-market). Nvidia said it would put $3B into the offering; Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom together showed interest in up to $5B of Class A shares. Meta is a major buyer of Nvidia AI chips. Nvidia's own closing move not verified.

items.summary: Semiconductor stocks rose for a third straight session as Anthropic's IPO filing renewed AI-demand focus; the SOX was up 3.2% around midday per Reuters (closing move not given).

items.headline: Banks and Blackstone line up $63B to finance Broadcom AI chips for Anthropic
items.summary: BofA, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley will provide $63B for a special purpose vehicle to buy Broadcom AI chips and networking gear and lease them to Anthropic; Broadcom provides residual value support to lenders. About $43.5B is senior debt. Deliveries expected to begin in 2027. Moody's said Broadcom is among the strongest large tech companies but risk rises if many such deals occur quickly. Shares were up almost 4% around midday per Reuters; close not verified.
